decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - The depth of the proposed balconies is considered unsatisfactory in the form shown on the drawings submitted to date and this aspect of the scheme should be modified to ensure that the depth is reduced to 500mm.  Details of the balconies shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced.
description: Remove paint from river fascade, insert 1 no french window, new balconies to living room and bedroom, new stone cills to windows, refurbishment / replacement of cast iron and timber windows, replacement roof deck with new access dormer and spiral staircase, insertion of new structural steel beam and creation of new bedroom and river room from existing river room
